links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online orthopaedic patient educational materials (English and Spanish)
links.outcome: Cumulative average reading grade level (readability), plus word count, complex words and long sentences
links.effect: English: 9.6 ± 2.6 to 7.7 ± 1.9 (95% CI of difference, 1.68 to 2.15; p < 0.05), a reduction of 2.0 ± 1.8 grade levels. Spanish: 9.5 ± 1.5 to 8.3 ± 1.3 (95% CI, 1.17 to 1.45; p < 0.05), a reduction of 1.5 ± 1.2 grade levels. Word count, complex words and long sentences were also significantly reduced in both languages.
links.tradeoff: Rewritten text still did not reach the sixth-grade target (7.7 English, 8.3 Spanish), and the reduction was smaller for Spanish. Accuracy and similarity to the original content were reported as high.
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly lowered the reading grade level (improved comprehension) to 7.7 ± 1.9 (95% CI of difference, 1.68 to 2.15; p < 0.05) for English-language content and 8.3 ± 1.3 (95% CI, 1.17 to 1.45; p < 0.05) for Spanish-language content.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting (rewrite at sixth-grade level)
